Chrome Extension

includes a chrome-extension that captures deterministic execution traces of the Vault pipeline for individual instances. The debugger records pipeline activity, controller decisions, lifecycle transitions, and error events during application execution.

Dimensions

For best results, open the Chrome DevTools panel with the following minimum dimensions:

  • Width: 768px — below this threshold the extension switches to a narrow (stacked) layout.
  • Height: 500px — ensures the event list and detail panel are both visible without clipping.

When to Use the Extension
↑ top

The Chrome Extension is designed to help engineers inspect runtime behavior inside the Vault pipeline. It is particularly useful when investigating complex execution flows or performance issues.

  • Investigating unexpected pipeline behavior.
  • Tracing lifecycle transitions across FeatureCells.
  • Identifying performance bottlenecks in pipeline stages.
  • Debugging controller policy conflicts.
  • Generating diagnostic reports for issue tracking.
